# ValidateController

> Runs validation rules against a value and dispatches `ui-valid` or `ui-invalid` events.

## Constructor

```ts
new ValidateController(host: HTMLElement, options?: ValidateOptions)
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Required | Description |
|--------|------|----------|-------------|
| `rules` | `ValidationRule[]` | no |  |

## Events Dispatched

| Event | Detail |
|-------|--------|
| `ui-invalid` | `{ message, value }` |
| `ui-valid` | `{ value }` |

## Methods

| Method |
|--------|
| `validate()` |
| `clearValidation()` |
| `destroy()` |

## Usage

```ts
import { ValidateController } from '@nonoun/native-ui';
const ctrl = new ValidateController(element, { /* options */ });
// In teardown: ctrl.destroy();
```
